quest.title: Fallen Tears
quest.description: The Holy Lyre is in poor condition, but you manage to restore some of its Anemo power by using Dvalin's tears. To restore its full power, you will need to look for more tears.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x20, Mora x6000, Character EXP x3125, Fine Enhancement Ore x7

talks.objective: Go to the Thousand Winds Temple

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Hey Diluc, I heard that the Fatui have recently proclaimed you "persona non grata."

talks.objective: Defeat the monsters guarding the ruin to complete the challenge

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon didn't think we'd find Dvalin's tears in a place like this.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: As knights, we are taught to hone our investigative skills.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Are you really going to call me the "Tone-Deaf Bard" forever? Poor me...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I don't know how they came to this, but... okay, I guess.
